information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTExNjcxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--18b4f661fc787a0b10e6192316ac1224d543eebc/WhatsApp%20Image%202025-07-16%20at%207.06.28%20AM.jpeg) > Español: ¡Bienvenidos al MalecOpen Mazatlán 2025, la segunda competencia oficial en Sinaloa! Con el icónico Malecón de Mazatlán como escenario, uno de los más largos y hermosos del mundo, este torneo promete una experiencia única frente al Pacífico. Competidores del noroeste mexicano y más allá se reunirán para disfrutar, aprender y demostrar su habilidad en distintas categorías. El evento es organizado por Sinaloa SpeedCube Team, Team Nayarit y Baja Cubing, y está avalado por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Todos los participantes deben conocer el reglamento oficial antes del evento. > English: Welcome to MalecOpen Mazatlán 2025, the second official competition in the state of Sinaloa! With the iconic Malecón of Mazatlán as its backdrop, one of the longest and most beautiful boardwalks in the world, this tournament offers a unique experience by the Pacific Ocean. Cubers from the northwestern region of Mexico and beyond will gather to compete, learn, and enjoy a variety of events. This event is organized by Sinaloa SpeedCube Team, Team Nayarit, and Baja Cubing, and is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). All competitors must be familiar with the official regulations prior to the competition.
